record.paper_title: Recent Progress and Open Problems in Algorithmic Convex Geometry
record.original_question: If X is drawn from an isotropic logconcave density f on R^n, must the variance of the squared Euclidean norm ||X||^2 be bounded linearly in the dimension? In other words, does there exist an absolute constant C such that Var_f(||X||^2) ≤ C n for every isotropic logconcave density?

evidence.quote: I Conjecture 12 (Thin shell). For X drawn from a logconcave isotropic density f in R^n, Var_f (kXk^2) ≤ Cn

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A probability density $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to[0,\infty)$ is called logconcave if $\log f$ is concave on its support (with the convention $\log 0=-\infty$), and isotropic if a random vector $X$ with density $f$ satisfies $\mathbb{E}[X]=0$ and $\mathbb{E}[XX^\top]=I_n$ (the $n\times n$ identity matrix). For such a vector $X$, write $\|X\|^2=\sum_{i=1}^n X_i^2$ and $\mathrm{Var}_f(\|X\|^2)=\mathbb{E}[\|X\|^4]-(\mathbb{E}[\|X\|^2])^2$.

Prove or disprove: there exists an absolute constant $C>0$ (independent of $n$ and of $f$) such that, for every dimension $n\geq 1$ and every isotropic logconcave density $f$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$,
$$\mathrm{Var}_f(\|X\|^2)\leq C\,n.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The thin-shell conjecture was long open with progressively better sub-linear bounds (Klartag, Fleury, Guédon–Milman, Lee–Vempala, Chen, Klartag–Lehec, Guan). Recent work by Klartag and Lehec ("Thin-shell bounds via parallel coupling", arXiv:2507.15495, 2025) is reported to resolve the conjecture, establishing a constant-width thin-shell estimate and hence the linear variance bound $\mathrm{Var}(\|X\|^2)\leq Cn$.

status_evidence.title: Thin-shell bounds via parallel coupling
status_evidence.snippet: Klartag and Lehec construct a coupling between log-affine perturbations to obtain thin-shell bounds resolving the conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The 2025 Klartag–Lehec paper resolves the thin-shell conjecture, implying a linear variance bound for the squared norm of an isotropic logconcave vector.

status_evidence.title: Qingyang Guan, Joseph Lehec and Bo'az Klartag Solved The Slice Conjecture! — Combinatorics and more
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of breakthroughs by Guan, Lehec and Klartag on slicing and related thin-shell/KLS questions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent breakthroughs by Guan, Klartag and Lehec resolve longstanding conjectures in the thin-shell/KLS/slicing circle of problems.
